score_notes.D: Hard parts get help at the right moment: no-box defined (L616), ROP expanded (L719), SecAlign worked loss example (L394), PoisonedRAG worked attack example (L468), the assistant-agent example runs through every section. Deductions: trivial figure narration (L282 '위 그림은 자유도 수준별 공격 성공률을 ... 보여줍니다', L306 '위 그림이 이 비교를 담고 있습니다') and repeated definitions of GCG pad the text.

top_issues: ToolHijacker's 84.6%-97.5% range is SecAlign's alone (StruQ reaches 99.6%), yet it is attributed to both defenses three times (L634, L654, L674), with a false claim that the paper gives no model or variant.
GCG table cell 'GPT-3.5/4 최대 ASR 84%' (L688) is not in the paper: 84% is Llama-2's held-out number, and GPT-3.5/GPT-4 are 86.6/46.9 (ensemble) or 87.9/53.6 (intro).

Repetition and meta prose: the same results are restated across the cards, the second table and the synthesis (ToolHijacker, CaMeL, Marking 76%); about 20 '글쓴이의 해석/가상의 예' labels; input talk at L634/L640; and a dangling back-reference at L542.
